projects.name: 生物防治中的竞争排斥模型研究
projects.program: Provincial Undergraduate Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training Program
projects.summary: This project uses dynamical systems and differential-equation modeling to study competitive exclusion in biological control. The model includes diffusion and aggregation terms to examine population competition, spatially heterogeneous resources, and individual aggregation behavior.
highlights: Led model derivation, qualitative analysis of the dynamical model, and numerical simulation.
Used MATLAB for equation discretization, parameter experiments, and visualization.
